text.en:
Creation of Barangay Tagukon. - The sitio
of Tagukon is hereby separated from Barangay Camingawan
in the City of Kabankalan, Province of Negros Occidental and
constituted as a distinct and independent barangay to be known
as Barangay Tagukon.
